text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Buckle up! Time for a one-on-one!

Hearing a spirited voice echoing from the
direction of the pool, I
decide to go take a
look.

There I find two clusters of students
buzzing excitedly around Hishi
Amazon
and Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hello, Trainer! Did you come to watch
this month's "Battle of the
Dorms: Pool
Edition" too?

text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This one's a competition to
decide which dorm's in
charge of cleaning
the pool!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. It might be nice to clean it
together once in a while as well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nope, the loser's gotta do it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I mean, don't get me wrong. It's not that I don't like cleaning, even if it is hard work.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But as the proud leader of the Miho Dorm,
I'll be damned if I lose to
my Ritto
counterpart!

text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Woo, that's our Hishiama! You've got this
one in the bag! Hope you're
ready, Ritto
Dorm!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I should have known you'd see it
that way, Hishiama.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Not that I don't share your sentiment. I
couldn't bear to dampen the
spirits of my
darling ponies any further.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As head of Ritto Dorm, I shall rise up to
this challenge!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Squee! You're the absolute coolest, Fuji! Get out there and show those Miho Dorm scrubs who's boss!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Let's see how we'll be battling it
out!

With that, a student comes running over
holding five strips of paper,
each bearing a
potential challenge.

Tasked with deciding the theme for their
match, Amazon selects one
of the slips...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What?! A-a pop quiz showdown?

text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Of all the things...
That's the type
of contest she struggles
with the most!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a lucky break! Fuji's got
everything—including brains! Miho Dorm
doesn't stand a chance.
Ritto's practically
won already!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Argh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: No... You never know until you try!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna throw in the towel before we
even start! It's you and
me,
Fuji—one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
I had a feeling you'd say that! Then
without further ado, let's
get this show on
the road!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hello,
hello! You'll need a neutral party to
ask the questions, and
since I don't belong
to Miho or Ritto, I'll do the honors!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for agreeing to help us,
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, think nothing of it.
This is fun for me
too! ♪ Now then, let's kick
things off with
our first question!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
When too many people are involved in
managing or making a decision, it can end
up complicating matters. In other words,
"Too
many cooks"...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ooh, me! Me, me, me, me, me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My, that was fast! Hishiama, your answer,
if you please!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh. So basically, it's bad news when
there's no clear leader to rally
behind,
right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
everyone can just follow me!
I'll take any and all under
my wing! That's
my answer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! That sounds just like you. But as
much as I adore your
response, I'm sorry to
say it's incorrect.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I believe the answer is "Too many
cooks spoil the broth." Right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Correct! That's one point for Fuji! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What?! Dammit... Bring on the next one!

Although Amazon is consistently first to
buzz in, she nevertheless answers each
question incorrectly,
causing the point gap to gradually
widen.
However...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Here comes the final question! "Many
drops make a shower"—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Awww yeeeah! Me, me, meee!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The answer is "Every little bit helps"!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Ding, ding, ding! That's
one-hundred percent correct,
Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
By the way, the full question was, "'Many
drops make a shower.' What
is the
meaning of this proverb?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha, how 'bout them apples? I'm not
too shabby at English lit!
Plus, I just came
across that phrase the other day—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I taught you that proverb when I was
helping you study for your
makeup exam.
I'm so glad you remembered it,
Hishiama! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sh-shut it! I still got the answer right!

In the end, Amazon only answers that one
question correctly, and the
match ends in
a landslide victory for Fuji and the Ritto
Dorm.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Argh, I can't believe I lost!
Sorry, guys! I
was totally useless out there...

text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No! That's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You refused to give up even when things
weren't going your way, and you kept
fighting right up to the very last moment.
It seriously lit a
fire in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Really? Hehe! You sure know how to make
a gal blush.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well,
a loss is a loss. Let's get that pool
spick and span! I'll spearhead
the
scrubbing, so try to keep up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And you can bet I won't lose to Fuji next
time around! I'll have my
revenge—just you
wait and see!

text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap...

I leave with a striking impression of
Hishi
Amazon as someone who
refuses to run
away, no matter the situation.
